verdict.rationale: Bento documents its own framework integrations, such as a Google ADK extra that captures every call automatically, and says it captures LLM calls at the SDK level and ingests spans from any framework over OpenTelemetry. However, none of the named frameworks (LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, the Vercel AI SDK) is explicitly documented as an integration, and SDKs without one require manual track_ai wrapping. Missing for 10: explicit LangChain, OpenAI SDK and Vercel AI SDK integrations; a documented integration catalog; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: If you use **Google ADK**, install the extra so Bento can capture every call automatically
Capture every model call, tool call, and agent step from a Google ADK app with one line.
Every span from every framework, captured over OpenTelemetry.
Bento captures every LLM call at the SDK level.
